summary: Greenpro Capital Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement to its CEO of 28,949 common shares at $1.7272 per share for $50,000 gross proceeds, issued under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D. The filing discloses the officer's resulting beneficial ownership (10.38% direct, ~11.3% with spouse) but lacks any price premium, board recommendation, advisor, or strategic catalyst beyond ordinary capital raising. There are no acquisition, divestiture, spin-off, tender, restructuring, or activist elements. The transaction is a routine unregistered equity sale, not a special situation.
